Only non-mutating commands are pre-approved, so a cloud or web agent can

Note the fmt and clippy entries are pinned to their exact check-only
forms. A bare `cargo fmt` rewrites sources and `cargo clippy --fix`
applies suggestions, so a `cargo fmt:*` style prefix would have granted
write access to the tree -- the opposite of what this template promises.
